statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-59888 is an improperly controlled modification of dynamically-determined object attributes in jackson-databind before 2.21.5 / tools.jackson 3.1.5. The staged 1.6.0.1 image uses fixed jackson-databind 2.21.5 on the application classpath; Scout identifies the affected 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 PURLs only inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing either relocated databind package, so the shaded copies are not on an execution path for MCE consumer deserialization.

CVE-2026-54513 makes BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator.Builder.allowIfSubTypeIsArray() accept an array without validating its component type. The staged 1.6.0.1 image uses fixed jackson-databind 2.21.5 on the application classpath; Scout identifies the affected 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 PURLs only inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing either relocated databind package, and no enableDefaultTyping, activateDefaultTyping, or allowIfSubTypeIsArray call outside the relocated Jackson classes. The vulnerable shaded code therefore has no execution path in this image.

CVE-2026-59889 is an @JsonView authorization bypass for properties also annotated with @JsonUnwrapped. The staged 1.6.0.1 image carries the affected 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 copies only as relocated classes inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar; the application classpath uses fixed jackson-databind 2.21.5. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing the relocated databind packages, but the shaded copies remain under investigation pending an upstream Hazelcast update.

The built image SBOM locates jackson-databind 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar in nifi-hazelcast-services-nar, and jackson-databind 2.21.3 inside parquet-jackson-1.17.1.jar in nifi-iceberg-parquet-writer-nar. NiFi's Maven dependency management cannot directly replace these embedded copies. Remediation requires upgrading the enclosing artifacts: Parquet 1.18.0 embeds jackson-databind 2.22.1 but requires compatibility validation, while Hazelcast currently has no newer release that embeds fixed jackson-databind 2.x and 3.x versions.
